backup.production_rule: Pay-in-full rule (D-428 to D-430). 20261208000000 sets terms.deposit_pct from 50 to 100 on the Cascade property's live and scheduled booking_rate_policy_versions rows (past versions keep 50); no other column changes. 20261208000100 replaces one sentence in two house_facts rows (smart-lock-prospect, smart-lock-staff): the door PIN follows payment, IDs and the PHP 800 refundable deposit instead of 'IDs and the balance'. Both are guarded updates that stop (55000) unless the rows hold the expected old value; no table, function or grant changes; no stored booking changes.
backup.notes: Apply together with or after the edge deploy of the s138 functions (the code ignores deposit_pct for the amount due, so order does not change any charge). The migrations carry no begin/commit (the runner wraps them).

forward_verification.name: no_live_or_scheduled_version_below_100
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.booking_rate_policy_versions where property_id = '6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd' and (effective_to is null or effective_to >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Manila')::date) and coalesce(terms ->> 'deposit_pct', '50')::numeric <> 100)

forward_verification.name: pin_rows_name_the_deposit_not_the_balance
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 and bool_and(body like '%PHP 800%' and body not like '%the balance%') from public.house_facts where topic in ('smart-lock-prospect', 'smart-lock-staff')

rollback.safe_until: Any time, losing nothing: both scripts restore the seeded values and write nothing else.

feature_flags.required_state: None. The edge code already treats the amount due as the whole stay whatever deposit_pct says.
